title: Independent audit of offline daily macro metric contracts
objective: Independently verify that MACRO-DAILY-OFFLINE-001 implements only the research-verified, offline macro metric contract with complete provenance, strict Robinhood partial coverage and no provider, collector or future-chain activation.
forbidden_actions: Do not modify source, migrations, tests, fixtures, task specifications, ledger, provider configuration, credentials, schedules or delivery integration.
Do not execute Dune queries, use credentials, make network calls, or run a database migration against any database.
Do not approve a BSC or Robinhood CA adapter, production collector, webhook, backfill, Feishu delivery, trading, signing or execution capability.
Do not treat a test fixture identifier as evidence of a real Dune query execution or a real Spellbook git pin.
acceptance_criteria: All changed implementation files are inside MACRO-DAILY-OFFLINE-001 write_set; existing migrations and source remain unchanged.
Migration creates exactly the three scoped macro tables and no cohort table, with query_ref, query_version, source_as_of, computed_at, completeness and warnings retained in every observation table.
Only the task whitelist is accepted; Four.meme, stablecoin, bridge, TVL, market-cap, FDV and survival/drawdown cohort metrics are rejected or absent.
Global and per-chain outputs remain separate and contain no score, recommendation or execution rule.
Robinhood requires partial_coverage and a syntactically pinned Uniswap v2/v3/v4 Spellbook registry string for both daily metrics and hourly profiles.
Hourly profiles require UTC hours 0 through 23 and query version provenance.
No task file introduces network, provider, scheduler, Feishu, credentials, live Dune, BSC/Robinhood adapter, collector or database-execution behavior.
